title: Chapter 888
paragraphs: Chapter 888
Episode 222. Yona's Observation (1)
Kinzelo Headquarters.
From the day Orgal provided support to the fortress, Yona had left the Lutero Magic Federation and infiltrated Kinzelo's territory.
"Hehehe, Lord Ainas! Look at this. It's a queen ant! The queen ant we've been looking for has finally shown itself."
"Oh, Bubar! It's really a queen ant...! It's huge! Almost the size of an arm?"
Of course, the actual size of the ant was about half a finger.
"Let's report to the chief right away."
"Hehe, good, Bubar! We will surely get a big reward!"
Seeing these two observing ants in the front yard of the headquarters every day, Yona grew curious.
'What are these foolish creatures doing in Kinzelo?'
Bubar was clear. He created various artifacts, including magic stones, with an ability called 'sculpture,' and thanks to that, he always received special treatment no matter how foolish he acted.
But Ainas Caligo didn't really do anything.
She was just Bianca Caligo's younger sister, holding a high status as a princess of the Caligo family. Apart from these facts, Ainas looked like a mere surplus resource.
'Heh, it would be great if I could get information that the youngest would like today.'
While Yona was hiding her energy even more, Bubar and Ainas put the queen ant in a glass bottle.
"Hehehehe."
"Hehehehe. What kind of reward will we get?"

The two fools of Kinzelo didn't know, but Yona knew that Orgal wasn't in the headquarters now. In the morning, she had confirmed that he and Zephrin had gone somewhere through the steel door while walking around inside the headquarters.
Therefore, there was no one 'definitely' able to recognize her in the headquarters now, as she was hiding her presence to the utmost.
'If I enter the meeting room, the only dangerous ones would be Bianca, White Meat, and Red Meat.'
Bianca, Beroct, Badrei.
After pondering about those three for a moment, Yona decided to enter the meeting room. It was worth taking that much risk to get new information.
Of course, Bubar and Ainas didn't notice Yona, who was sticking right behind them. It was the same with numerous beastmen and demons they met on the way to the meeting room.
"Chief!"
"We can finally show you the queen ant!"
The two shouted cheerfully as they kicked open the meeting room door. Upon seeing them, Bishkel touched his forehead, and other executives sighed and reached out their hands.
Yona hid behind a pillar on one side of the meeting room at that moment, which was the most dangerous time.
'Heh, if those foolish creatures hadn't distracted attention for a moment, I might have been caught. It seems like there's no White Meat and Red Meat.'
Although most of the major superhumans, including Orgal and Zephrin, were absent, Yona was a bit tense as she did not know the exact identities of the executives gathered in the meeting room.
Fortunately, the executives did not sense anything unusual and were scolding Bubar and Ainas.
"Queen ant? Did you say queen ant? What am I supposed to do with such a thing you brought? Bubar, how much longer will you upset me...?"
"Eh, Lord Bishkel. What are you upset about? Last time, the chief said that there's no ant the size of an arm, and if we bring such a thing, he would reward us."
"That's right, deputy chief!"
"No... The chief just said that to fool around because he was frustrated by your actions, Ainas."
"What are you talking about? Are you judging things your way because the chief is not here?"
"Well, the ant isn't as big as an arm in the first place."
"That's just a figure of speech, a figure of speech! Don't you even know what a metaphor is, deputy chief? Where is the chief?"
"The chief has gone to meet the Red Eye Tribe."
Already good information had come in.
'Hehe, he said he went to meet the Red Eye Tribe.'
Yona grinned and kept her ears open. Bishkel was trembling and sighing continuously.
"Hey, Ainas. We are having an important meeting, so get out."
"Who are you, Ranke, to tell me to leave?"
"Do you really want to get hit?"
"Huh, are you challenging me? I'll take you on anytime."
Ranke stood up in anger and then calmed his rage.
"Fine, fine. If I hit you, it will only cause problems..."
"If you're afraid of my sister and backing off, there's no need. I won't tell my sister, so come at me."
"Do you think I'm afraid of Bianca? If I hit you, Hwanmajang will kill me."
As soon as she heard the word 'Hwanmajang', Yona recalled the information Jinny had told her.
-[Understood. Shagal Bahuma, who was suppressed by the chieftain in the headquarters, is from the Illusion Demon Tribe, so I'll try to find information related to him.]
Then Hwanmajang must be the head of the Bahuma family.
Ainas, seemingly insulted, shouted in a harsh voice.
"I won't tell my dad either! You're really pissing me off!"
It was the moment it was revealed that Ainas Caligo was the daughter of the head of the Bahuma family. And then, a new person entered as the meeting room door opened.
"Ranke, did you by any chance harass my daughter?"
"Lord Hwanmajang, not at all. Ainas picked a fight with me one-sidedly, I just stayed put."
"I see."
"Have you arrived, Pylops?"
Pylops Bahuma, that was the name of Hwanmajang.
"Yes. You've been working hard, Vice Chief."
"It's nothing compared to the work you've been doing recently, Pylops."
Yona was getting more and more excited. Just one visit to the meeting room had led to a wealth of information.
However, the tension rose sharply as soon as Pylops walked in.
'I feel like that Hwanmajang fish will recognize me right away.'
Fortunately, Pylops seemed extremely tired. If Pylops had been in good shape, she would have been immediately discovered.
'I can only hope that Hwanmajang doesn't stay long in the meeting room. Heh, it's been a while since my heart's been racing.'
Soon Yona was able to learn why Pylops was so tired.

"I do have a lot of work. Those not of our tribe may not understand, but looking into someone's dream is a tormenting task... One might get lost in the other's dream. In fact, this time, three Hwanmas have yet to return from diving into the dreams of the Zipple leaders."
Upon hearing that, Yona immediately understood how Kinzelo had recently obtained information about Zipple.
-Elona's information seems to have been obtained not through trade, but something else, Gongja.

-I think so too. Considering the peace during the invasion of the demon world... Let's see what they have up their sleeves. Jet, contact Mumei and request to dispatch Sister Yona to Kinzelo. Since we can't get through to Elona, it would be better to keep an eye on Kinzelo.
-Yes, Lord!
-One thing is certain, there's something in Kinzelo now that the Demon World must not see.
A conversation between Jin and his colleagues after Orgal decided to support the barrier.
At the time, Jin was puzzled as to how Orgal had learned about Elona's injury. Yona was now peeking into that secret.
"Will those three never regain consciousness?"
"Unless I personally rescue them, yes. Our tribe values dream abilities greatly, so they must be saved. Which means I have to go into the dream of Elona Zipple once more."
"I'm sorry there's nothing I can do to help."
"What have you to be sorry for, Vice Chief? All I hope is that our lovely daughter, Ainas, will awaken her dream ability soon and help her father."
"Oh, I like being a Caligo. Swords are much cooler than dream abilities! Like Sister Bianca."

"Oh, Ainas... you have not even a shred of talent in the sword like Bianca. To put it bluntly, an ordinary human with about ten years of training could probably beat you in a sword fight. On the other hand, if your dream ability blossoms, you will far surpass your father."
"Eek, how can dad speak so harshly to me?"

"We need your dream ability for our great cause. It's challenging for me to infiltrate the dreams of Lokia Ganesto with my power. So stop being stubborn and follow me. Our demon kind has always treated dream manipulators with the highest respect."
The potential for dream ability surpassing that of the phantom lord, that was the value held by Ainas Caligoga.
"Chet, last time, at Dad's almost desperate request, I went into Kelliark's dream even though I didn't feel like it. It was no fun at all then. How can I do that for a lifetime?"

"Only you were born with such an ability, Ainas. If you keep refusing my request, I have no choice but to make the leader issue an order to you. I hope that such a dull thing does not happen between me and our daughter. Moreover, Lanke... This punk! How dare you threaten my daughter?"
"No, Phantom Lord, it's not like that!"
"Die, die you bastard!"
For a moment, Yona heard the sound of Phirophs assaulting Lanke. Yona, her eyes wide open, recapped the information she had just heard.
'So, Kinzelo has already contacted Kelliark Zephyr through dreams?'
The moment she had that thought.
Suddenly, Phirophs narrowed his eyes and stopped the fist reaching out to Lanke.
'Hee, did he notice...'
Yona couldn't see his face directly as she was behind the pillar, but she could feel the change in the air.
"Phirophs?"
"Shh, for some reason... I feel like there's a rat hiding somewhere."
"A rat?"
"Hmm, isn't it? Anyway, stop everything. Don't even breathe, I need to look around the meeting room."

Phirophs slowly started to scan the meeting room. The distance between Yona and the pillar where she was hiding was about fifty steps. The moment she moved even slightly, she would be immediately detected.
Even if she remained still, she would be caught within about ten seconds. Yona put her hand on her sword 'Death' that she had with her.
Just as Phirophs began to step towards the pillar where Yona was hiding.
Suddenly, someone rushed into the meeting room.
"What's the matter?"
"Vice-Captain, Phirophs! Miss Marjiella is rampaging!"
Upon receiving the member's report, Phirophs immediately turned around without a moment's hesitation, as if he couldn't afford to waste even a second.
"Ainas, follow me!"
"I will also go!"
As Phirophs and Bisuchel left, Yona relaxed the grip on her sword, Death.
The executives, including Lanke, thoroughly searched the meeting room, shrugging their shoulders, but they could not find and catch Yona with their abilities.
'Hee, that was a close call... I need to go and inform my younger brother quickly.'
About twenty minutes later, Yona came out of the new headquarters, humming a tune.
